en: Black-and-white street scene showing a corner apartment building with balconies, with an apotek (pharmacy) on the ground floor. The view captures intersecting roads, a few pedestrians, older cars, street lamps, and utility poles, with a water tower visible in the background. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge, along with a small code in the lower right corner.
